notes: "Tycoon" is the self-declared genre and the earn-and-upgrade loop is the frame, so Simulation leads, but weapons and direct PvP against other players' modern military bases are real Shooter work rather than theme, so Shooter is named second and supplies cover and the weapon rack. Six selectable bases, one per player, is per-player buildable ground, so I kept the Tycoon preset and substituted plot-isolated for plot-shared; the usual sealed-plot reading is bent here because the author's answer says players raid each other's bases directly, so the plots are spaced and mutually reachable rather than screened off, and spawn-teambase is worded as six balanced bases shielded from each other's firing lines rather than two opposing ends. Decided without a user: the bases are open-air walled compounds with cover arrays rather than enterable buildings, which keeps the build on P0 - interiors to breach would need P3 and are not asked for, so I left them out and flagged it here as the upgrade if the author wants room-to-room raiding. Stated count to carry forward: exactly six bases.
